name: Underworld
description: The realm beyond death where Erebos rules, the titans are sealed, and Elspeth is imprisoned.

description_citations.text: "War of the Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Erebos sends Athreos to fetch Daxos for his oracular gift; Lidia takes her son's place and is brought to the Underworld.
timeline.quote: thus she was brought to the Underworld while Daxos was left alone in the Mortal Realm.

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Silence of the Gods leaves Erebos unable to receive souls, causing a buildup of eidolons and Returned.
timeline.quote: leaving him unable to receive souls into the Underworld

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: When Elspeth defeats Heliod, Erebos places him beneath a boulder in the Underworld and gives Elspeth his gratitude and safe passage home.
timeline.quote: Erebos took the defeated sun god and placed him beneath a giant boulder in the Underworld

citation.text: "Erebos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth fights Heliod at the borders of the Underworld and shatters his spear; Erebos chains Heliod beneath a boulder.
timeline.quote: chained Heliod into the Underworld beneath a giant boulder.

citation.text: "Heliod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Returned escape the underworld via the Path of Phenax, losing their identities, and gather in the necropoleis.
timeline.quote: The necropoleis of Asphodel and Odunos house the Returned, undead beings who have escaped the underworld at the cost of their identities.

citation.text: "Mortal Realm", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Originally a mortal trapped in the Underworld, Phenax hides from Erebos and Athreos by forsaking his identity and crosses back wrapped in Athreos's cloak, becoming the first Returned.
timeline.quote: This escape established his role as the first Returned and set him on the path to godhood.

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Underworld". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phenax becomes the first mortal to escape the land of the dead by using the Tartyx's waters to strip himself of identity.
timeline.quote: Phenax was the first mortal to find a route of escape out of the land of the dead

citation.text: "Returned", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Other denizens of the Underworld replicate his escape, some assisted by Phenax, creating the Returned.
timeline.quote: other denizens of the Underworld replicated his escape

citation.text: "Returned", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The gods, born from mortal prayer, seal the titans away in the Underworld with Klothys as eternal jailer.
timeline.quote: the gods sealed the titans away in the Underworld

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The sealing of the titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth, empowered by Ashiok, escapes the Underworld to assassinate Heliod.
timeline.quote: Elspeth became empowered by Ashiok , who equipped her with a weapon created from her past traumas

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "War of the gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Fearing replacement, Heliod strikes Elspeth down and casts her into the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Fearful, he struck her down in her moment of triumph, casting her into the Underworld to be forgotten.

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's nightmares torment Elspeth; in one vision she seizes Heliod's spear Khrusor and a twisted version remains.
timeline.quote: in one of them, Elspeth seized Heliod's spear, Khrusor.

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Klothys leaves the Underworld, leaving the titans unguarded for the first time in millennia.
timeline.quote: leaving the titans unguarded for the first time in millennia.

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth awakens with the Shadowspear and heads for a hidden exit, gathering followers and claiming Heliod's spear is the fake.
timeline.quote: Her believers gave her weapon power, and simultaneously weakened Heliod.

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Klothys weaves Calix to pursue Elspeth; Elspeth defeats him repeatedly on her way to the exit.
timeline.quote: So Klothys weaved her masterpiece: an agent of fate she called Calix .

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod's spear shatters against the Shadowspear and the onlookers' belief makes Elspeth's lie true; Heliod yields.
timeline.quote: Staring down the point of a spear that was no longer his, Heliod yielded.

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Erebos places the defeated Heliod beneath a boulder and gives Elspeth safe passage back to the mortal realm.
timeline.quote: Erebos simply took the defeated sun god and placed him beneath a giant boulder

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After a brief reunion with Daxos Elspeth planeswalks away, and Calix sparks and planeswalks after her.
timeline.quote: a spark flared inside him, and he planeswalked after her

citation.text: "War of the Gods", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Penthikos descends a cave, kills shades, and black ichor encases his face.
timeline.quote: With every blow, more of the foul ichor poured down my face.

citation.text: "Tragedy". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Penthikos reaches the river's edge and meets a robed woman who tells him he has no face to pay the boatman.
timeline.quote: You bring no face for the boatman. How will you cross?

citation.text: "Tragedy". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Penthikos defies fate and crosses the river, paying his crystallized mask to the ferryman.
timeline.quote: The price paid, we drifted across to that bleak land.

citation.text: "Tragedy". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Alkmenos, who refused to bow to Erebos in death, is bowed for eternity.
timeline.quote: Proud Alkmenos, who would not bow to Erebos in death, is now bowed by his own hubris for all eternity.

citation.text: Weight of the Underworld (Born of the Gods, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Erebos sends Athreos to take Daxos to the Underworld; despite Karametra's efforts Athreos seizes the boy, and Lidia offers herself in his place and is taken instead.
timeline.quote: Lidia offered herself in her son's place and was taken to the Underworld instead.

citation.text: "Athreos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kydele helps Deiphon's soul pass to the Underworld and thanks Keranos for the lightning.
timeline.quote: "Thank you for the lightning, Keranos," the oracle said to the sky.

citation.work: Theros eBook Godsend , Part 1: Sample Chapter
citation.text: "Theros eBook Godsend , Part 1: Sample Chapter". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Apr 2014. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The satyr tells of the Underworld's coinsmiths who mint ostraka from funerary masks, and explains that Erebos equalizes everyone and forbids a return except as one of the Returned.
timeline.quote: Erebos cares little for what you were in life. He only cares that you once existed.

citation.text: "The Path or the Horizon" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 May 2014.

timeline.summary: Phenax became the first mortal to escape the Underworld, and later a god.
timeline.quote: As a mortal, Phenax was the first to escape the Underworld.

citation.text: Minion's Return (Theros Beyond Death, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Some despondent archons take refuge in the Underworld and are twisted into monstrous variants.
timeline.quote: Some of the despondent archons took refuge in the Underworld

citation.text: "Archon", section "Ashen Riders". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Long ago the titans are sealed in the Underworld and Klothys volunteers as their eternal jailer.
timeline.quote: it was Klothys who volunteered to serve as their eternal jailer.

citation.text: "Klothys", section "The binding of the titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As war breaks out among the gods, Erebos is consumed by hatred of Heliod and begins to lose control of his realm's souls.
timeline.quote: Erebos was consumed by his hatred of Heliod

citation.text: "Klothys", section "Return to the mortal world". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Phenax becomes the first mortal to escape the Underworld unnoticed by Athreos or Erebos.
timeline.quote: Phenax was the first mortal to escape the Underworld without drawing the notice of Athreos or Erebos

citation.text: "Odunos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tymaret witnesses Phenax's escape and informs Erebos, who lets him leave the Underworld as a Returned to catch Phenax.
timeline.quote: The only witness to Phenax's escape was Tymaret

citation.text: "Odunos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the dark cave Penthikos cuts down shades, each death tearing at his soul.
timeline.quote: the death of each shade ripped at his heart and soul

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Penthikos is ferried across to the Underworld to take his place among the dead.
timeline.quote: the ancient barge silently slid forth from the fog

citation.text: "Penthikos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: According to a rarely whispered tale, Phenax was destined to free the Titans, so mortals killed him and the gods later allowed his escape.
timeline.quote: the gods later allowed his escape to protect themselves

citation.text: "Phenax", section "Phenax's Secret". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The gods are at war and bring their champions to fight.
timeline.quote: The Gods are at war, and they bring their champions to fight.

citation.text: "Theros Beyond Death", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth breaks free and defeats Heliod with a weapon created from her past traumas.
timeline.quote: Elspeth breaks free and defeats Heliod with a weapon created from her past traumas .

citation.text: "Theros Beyond Death", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Klothys learns Elspeth has escaped the Underworld and sends someone to bring her back or capture her.
timeline.quote: Klothys finds out about Elspeth escaping the Underworld so she is sending someone to bring her back to the Underworld or capture her.

citation.text: "Theros Beyond Death", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Klothys and Kruphix war against the titans and seal them in the Underworld with Klothys watching.
timeline.quote: Victorious, the twin gods sealed the Titans in the Underworld with Klothys to keep watch.

citation.text: "Underworld", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Klothys leaves the Underworld after the apotheosis of Xenagos.
timeline.quote: Klothys has lived in the Underworld ever since the binding of the Titans, but she left following the apotheosis of Xenagos to untangle the threads of fate in the mortal world.

citation.text: "Underworld", section "Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Celestial archons take refuge in the Underworld and are twisted into the Ashen Riders.
timeline.quote: There, their minds, souls, and bodies were twisted, turning them into sadistic monsters known as the Ashen Riders .

citation.text: "Underworld", section "Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Klothys traps Heliod in the Underworld as punishment for his hubris.
timeline.quote: Following the events of Theros Beyond Death , Heliod became trapped in the Underworld by Klothys as punishment for his hubris.

citation.text: "Underworld", section "Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion, Athreos shatters Kroxa's chains so it can destroy the Phyrexians in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Athreos shattered the chains that bound the titan, allowing it to lay waste to the Phyrexian forces.

citation.text: "Athreos", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Athreos sends Kunoros to accompany and restrain Kroxa so it cannot escape the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Athreos sent his hound, Kunoros , to accompany and restrain the titan during its rampage.

citation.text: "Athreos", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Erebos steals Anikthea away to Agonas.
timeline.quote: stole her away to Agonas, dragging her down through the mouth of Cirkis as she slept

citation.text: "Anikthea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Erebos pits his champions against her, then offers her freedom if she fights to the surface.
timeline.quote: offered her a deal: fight her way to the surface and win her freedom

citation.text: "Anikthea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Anikthea agrees to serve Erebos if she may protect her people, and becomes a demigod.
timeline.quote: she would serve Erebos as long as she could return home to protect her people when they needed her most

citation.text: "Anikthea", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth repeatedly clashes with Calix on her way out of the Underworld and defeats him each time, finally at the exit where Heliod awaits.
timeline.quote: she defeated him one final time as she reached the exit where Heliod awaited her

citation.text: "Calix", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The God of Destiny artificially creates Calix on Theros to keep Elspeth Tirel from escaping the Underworld.
timeline.quote: Calix was artificially created by the God of Destiny on the plane of Theros to prevent Elspeth Tirel from escaping the Underworld.

citation.text: "Calix". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The gods sealed the titans away in the Underworld, with Klothys as eternal jailer.
timeline.quote: the gods sealed the titans away in the Underworld

citation.text: "Kroxa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kroxa consumed the advancing Phyrexian forces so utterly that no remnants remained.
timeline.quote: Kroxa consumed the invading forces so utterly that no remnants remained

citation.text: "Kroxa", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Athreos broke Kroxa's chains, and entrusted Kunoros to guide him against the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: Athreos chose to break Kroxa’s chains

citation.text: "Kroxa", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Heliod strikes Elspeth down to the Underworld where Ashiok makes her relive her worst moments.
timeline.quote: struck her down to the Underworld

citation.work: Magic: The Gathering: Untold Stories - Elspeth
citation.text: "Magic: The Gathering: Untold Stories - Elspeth", section "Volume 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth becomes self-aware and lodges the Shadowspear in Ashiok's chest.
timeline.quote: lodges it directly in Ashiok's chest

citation.work: Magic: The Gathering: Untold Stories - Elspeth
citation.text: "Magic: The Gathering: Untold Stories - Elspeth", section "Volume 1". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elspeth faces the Nyxborn Agent of Fate, Calix.
timeline.quote: the reluctant hero faces an Agent of Fate

citation.work: Magic: The Gathering: Untold Stories - Elspeth
citation.text: "Magic: The Gathering: Untold Stories - Elspeth", section "Volume 3". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: He watches over the dead in the Underworld.
relations.quote: They dwell in this eternally gray realm without sun or night under the watch of Erebos, god of the Underworld.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

relations.note: Erebos seals the dead within the Underworld.
relations.quote: He seals us within the Underworld, from which there is no return

citation.text: "The Path or the Horizon" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 May 2014.

relations.note: The coinsmiths mint coins for use in the Underworld.
relations.quote: They mint coins for use in the Underworld.

citation.text: "The Path or the Horizon" by Adam Lee. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 May 2014.

relations.quote: While Erebos rules this realm beyond death

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "The sealing of the titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: The Underworld is governed by the god Erebos , who rules it with an iron whip.

citation.text: "Underworld", section "Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
